justification: Both depict profile human figures in low relief with accompanying script signs, and in each a principal figure with elaborate headgear extends arms toward another figure or focus. But the specifics differ entirely: A shows two large bearded, long-robed figures with fringed garments and a dagger, facing a smaller figure, with no writing integrated into the scene; B shows a solar disc emitting hand-tipped rays over a laden offering table flanked by slender adorants, framed by dense columns of pictographic signs.
